name: hive-formatter
description: SQL All in One - 强大的 SQL 格式化、智能补全、语法检查、DDL 转换 VSCode 插件，支持 Hive、MySQL、SparkSQL、FlinkSQL、PostgreSQL、BigQuery、SQLite 等多种 SQL 方言

commands.title: 切换注释 (SQL All in One)
切换高级注释 (SQL All in One)

SQL-All-in-One.query.maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows returned by query execution

enumDescriptions: Intercept all rules (warnings + confirmations require confirmation)
SQL-All-in-One.safetyGuard.level.description: Safety guard level for dangerous SQL operations

SQL-All-in-One.history.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of query history entries

SQL-All-in-One.execution.batchMode.description: Batch execution mode: sequential or transaction

SQL-All-in-One.execution.onError.description: Error handling strategy for batch execution

SQL-All-in-One.execution.saveProgress.description: Save batch execution progress for resumption

SQL-All-in-One.execution.cancelRetries.description: Number of retry attempts when cancelling a query

SQL-All-in-One.execution.cancelRetryDela.description: Delay between cancel retry attempts in milliseconds

SQL-All-in-One.query.pageSize.description: Number of rows per page in the query result panel

SQL-All-in-One.query.nullPlaceholder.description: Display text for NULL values in the result panel

SQL-All-in-One.results.enablePreload.description: Enable scroll preloading for large result sets

SQL-All-in-One.results.jsonPrettyPrint.description: Auto-format JSON values in the result panel

SQL-All-in-One.results.dateFormat.description: Date display format in the result panel

SQL-All-in-One.results.longTextThreshold.description: Character threshold for truncating long text in the result panel

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.editMode.description: Result panel edit mode (readonly or editable)

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.autoCommit.description: Auto commit mode for data editor changes

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.defaultView.description: Default view mode for result panel (grid or form)

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.optimisticLock.description: Enable optimistic locking for concurrent edit control

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.maxBlobPreview.description: Maximum BLOB preview size in bytes (default 5MB)

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.blobTextPrevie.description: Maximum BLOB text preview size in bytes (default 1MB)

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.longTransactio.description: Long transaction warning threshold in seconds

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.showTransactio.description: Show transaction status in the status bar

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.enableValidati.description: Enable data validation in the editor

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.validateOnEdit.description: Validate data in real-time during editing

SQL-All-in-One.dataEditor.validateForeig.description: Validate foreign key references (may impact performance)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
